fusions.name: Unpick the Seam
fusions.desc: A hooked cut along a seam that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Exposed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Snapped Winnowing Sheet
fusions.desc: Snaps a sheet out ahead of you and cuts through it, dealing 12 wind damage to everything in a cone 3.5 tiles long and stunning it for 1 second, with a 60% chance to leave each [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Hung Overhead
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 50% later, you move 10% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Frayed Thread
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage. Your dodge chance rises by 4%.
